explanation: This endpoint is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because an f-string embeds user_id directly inside single quotes in the WHERE clause while only parameterizing the SET value. An authenticated attacker supplying crafted input in user_id could alter the UPDATE statement to overwrite arbitrary users. The repair replaces the interpolated user_id with %s and adds it to parameters, though complete safety cannot be verified without seeing database_utilities.execute_query.
